intro_html: A savory Cuban-style turkey simmer with a little sweet-and-savory magic in every bite. At about $3.36 a serving (at everyday cost) with 47 grams of protein, this is a hearty, satisfying bowl. One skillet, 14 servings, done.
cost_closing_html: About $3.36 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 bowls delivers 47 grams of protein and about 552 calories.
upsell_html: Big flavor, tiny price, and it might just become a regular on your rotation. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: The 7 lb ground turkey pack is the smart buy and keeps the cost per serving down.
Canned diced tomatoes and tomato paste in the store brand do the heavy lifting for pennies.
Dry rice by the pound is the cheapest filler you can put in a bowl, so keep a bag on hand.
make_it: Brown the ground turkey in a large skillet, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and green peppers and cook until they soften.
Stir in the cumin, then the diced tomatoes and tomato paste.
Let it simmer 10 to 15 minutes so the flavors meld and the sauce thickens.
Serve the picadillo over cooked white rice.
